output.reason: [ev-df7847de6bcb] says that log messages which were not structured are now structured logs, and that this "could break your setup" only if you were matching on specific log strings. Whether an environment is exposed depends on how outside log consumers (parsers, alerts, dashboards) read cert-manager's log output. No Helm values key, flag, field or manifest records that, so an undecidable leaf is the right shape. However, the proposed reason "environment-visibility-gap" is not an allowed reason. The closest allowed reason is runtime-behavior-gap, because this is about who consumes the output at runtime, much like "which clients connect".

correction.statement: In cert-manager 1.17.0, log messages that were not structured are now structured logs. Exposed environments are those whose log pipelines, alerting rules, parsers or dashboards match on specific cert-manager log strings. Configuration cannot show this; it depends on how log output is consumed at runtime.

exposure.needed: whether any log pipeline, alerting rule, parser or dashboard consuming cert-manager log output matches on specific log message strings
